prediction_text: Direction (1) Irish forces: YES — his Majesty shall procure forces/aid out of Ireland against the Parliament, though slowly. The King is signified by the Moon in Cancer in the tenth in her own house, increasing in light and void of infelicity except slowness of motion (strong but slow), and the Sun lord of the eleventh (assistance/aid) is in the seventh in his exaltation applying to the cusp of the eleventh, wanting six degrees of partile — aid is real and strong but about six degrees/units off, so delayed. Direction (2) the Queen: she shall advance and the King shall meet her — the Moon wants only three or four degrees of a trine of Saturn, the Queen's significatrix, giving a meeting after about 3-4 units (weeks-to-months scale) — but she shall not prosper in the advance: Saturn is removing out of one sign into another and going into Aries, his fall, so her fortune falls as she comes on.
basis: King Moon Cancer 10th own house increasing void except slow; Sun lord 11th (aid) in 7th exalted applying cusp 11th wanting 6d, opp Asc (Parliament); Queen significatrix Saturn lord 4th (7th from 10th) changing sign into Aries fall; Moon wanting 3-4d of trine Saturn = meeting. Lilly: exalted aid lord applying = aid procured, significator entering fall = prosperity denied despite advance.
